entry_points.text: Tick entry needs disabled interrupts, skips exiting tasks and scheduled work, applies fast heuristic, then dispatches handling.
Process checks drain due timers and supervise resource limits; CPU sleep arms a temporary timer until expiry or signal.
Minimal syscalls read time, sleep to relative or absolute deadlines, and set wall time in native and compat widths for supported clocks.

exports.text: Thread and group CPU timer teardown discards all clock bases; per-task deferred-work control resets with fresh handler binding.
CPU clock tables expose resolution, read, timer and sleep behavior; tick probe chooses immediate handling or deferred task work.
Wall setting, frequency and offset discipline, and boot zone compensation apply only after validation.
Core, auxiliary and timezone state publish to shared readable areas; auxiliary clocks read in scalar or broken-down form.

hazards.text: Collection caps timers per pass deferring remainder; forwarding splits unbounded deltas to clock maximum to avoid overflow; publish orders seconds first under sequence to keep second readers safe.
Lock-free group check may defer expiry; collection firing-list reprogram or delete suppresses signal with retry; negative or noncanonical injects restore shadow without effects.
CPU clocks use tick granularity except scheduler one nanosecond; cap twenty per pass; auto sentinel most negative integer; stub set accepts only realtime.
Zone offset must stay within fifteen hours; normalization keeps nanoseconds canonical; absent leap uses maximum time without rebasing; reads during suspension or against invalid keepers fail.

invariants.text: Validation rejects out-of-range kinds, maps zero to caller or group, enforces thread-group scope, and samples scheduler versus user and system time.

Programming samples under lock, reports prior remainder, converts relative to absolute, arms only enabled future expiries, advances periodic timers by intervals with overrun count, fires immediately if due.
Arming enqueues and refreshes earliest hint; collection drains due timers and refreshes hints; cache is inactive only when all hints show none pending with idle using maximum unsigned.
Expiry detection combines hints with fresh sampling; deadline overrun forces handling even when no timer appears expired.

Nanosleep sleeps interruptibly with overrun negative one, captures remainder with retry while handling runs; self per-thread sleep is rejected, relative interrupt restarts versus absolute no-hand, zero identifiers alias scheduler clock.
Wall install forwards keeper, rejects monotonic-inverting deltas, shifts wall and monotonic offsets oppositely, requires canonical subseconds, and boot warp injects zone seconds once.
Shadow edits commit or restore on failure; publish uses write sequence with seconds-first ordering, fast readers use latch double buffer, forwarding advances in bounded chunks with normalization.
Readable publication shares one mode, refreshes detail only when capable, combines wall with monotonic and boot offsets normalized, and minimal readout supports only wall, monotonic and boot.
Lookup needs matching owner and identifier with transient marker; allocation reports busy on collision and exhausted after scan; global adjustment validates and requires liveness.

locks.text: Creation runs under read-side protection; deletion, programming and collection hold sighand, released before per-timer spin locks.
Deferred expiry serializes on per-task mutex; waiters pin handler, drop protection to block, sleep waiter drops irq lock around blocking, and realtime reenable rechecks for interleaved ticks.
Keeper inject holds keeper lock; insertion holds bucket lock while rechecking duplicates; readable publication is bracketed by markers with arch sync outside.

state_machines.text: Timers move disarmed to armed to collected to firing-listed, then unlinked, branching to event or silent drop after concurrent rearm or delete, with interval timers advanced and requeued.
Deferred work moves idle to scheduled on queue, to handling under mutex in task work, to reenable returning to idle or repeating collection when realtime ticks added expiries.
Nanosleep moves init to armed to waiting to success or interrupted to disarmed with retry; wall setting moves validation to forward to delta check to install to publish to notification.

Readable clocks switch available and unavailable on validity, skipping detail when unavailable; identifiers move unallocated to reserved with transient marker to visible with busy or exhausted outcomes.

structs.text: Per-task and per-signal state holds three bases with queue, hint and flags; timers carry queue and expiry linkage, firing marker and owner; work control holds work item, mutex and scheduled flag.
Keeper holds wall seconds, shifted fractions, coarse cache, offsets, leap instant and set sequence; fast state holds latch sequence with two read slots.
Restart holds clock, expiry and sleep type; buckets pair mutex and hash chain; published clock config carries cycle, mask, multiplier and shift.
